blocks.text: Capital expenditure requests above $1M require Finance approval and Board approval before Procurement may issue a purchase order.
The sponsor attaches a business case and three competitive bids. Finance and Security review the package in parallel.
Unless the CFO declares an emergency, no sole-source exception may bypass Board approval.

messages.text: Update: the Board approval is recorded in the investment portal; Procurement accepts the portal approval ID as evidence.
